brief:
Several Pacific island nations are pursuing plans to establish diplomatic missions in Jerusalem, driven partly by Christian interpretations of Biblical prophecy, according to Al-Monitor. The move reflects both religious conviction among political leaders and strategic calculations regarding international relations and recognition.

The effort represents a shift in how some smaller nations are approaching their foreign policy, blending theological commitments with diplomatic positioning. The development comes as a handful of countries have already moved or opened embassies in Jerusalem in recent years, a step most nations have avoided due to the city's contested status.
